rows.title: Sunset
notes: the audio briefly looked like Jim Legxacy - father, but the presenter said otherwise

rows.title: I Am the King of Everything
notes: “first up a track that's already been added to fbi rotation i am the king of everything by the artists themselves freddie”

Track 10 on FREDDY's 2025 bedroom cloud-rap album 'Fred The Conqueror' (Sydney/Eora artist, also half of duo Frooks); confirmed as opening track on this same FBi Radio 'The Bridge with Diana Kalkoul' Freddy interview episode.

rows.title: Cat Vibes
notes: Track 3 on 'Fred The Conqueror' (2025); FBi Radio flags it as a notable track in its FREDDY artist profile.

rows.title: Chokehold
notes: “we're coming off the back of Chokehold by Freddie”

Not on the released 'Fred The Conqueror' Bandcamp album, but confirmed as a real track played on this same episode via FBi Radio's own published tracklist — likely a SoundCloud-only cut from the pre-album mixtape era.

rows.title: Our Love Is a Symphony
notes: “play this next track which is our love is a symphony by freddie and looks”
Track 10 on 'Adventurine' (2025), the collaborative album between FREDDY and her partner Looks.

rows.title: Chewed Up
notes: “let's listen to it um chewed up by freddie off the fred the conqueror album chewed up”
Track 9 on 'Fred The Conqueror' (2025), exactly matching the presenter's description of it being off that album.

rows.title: My Inhibitions Rework
notes: “definitely with looks um my inhibitions rework uh featuring porcelain boy all right let's listen to it”
Sydney duo Porcelain Boy's rework featuring Looks; not on Porcelain Boy's Bandcamp discography page but confirmed as the closing music track on this same FBi Radio episode's published tracklist.
